info.title: hCaptcha verification code recognition service
info.description: API reference for hCaptcha verification code recognition service on Ace Data Cloud.

started_at.description: When the task began processing, as a Unix timestamp in seconds (float).

finished_at.description: When the task produced its result, as a Unix timestamp in seconds (float). Absent while the task is still processing.

elapsed.description: Processing time in seconds (float, 3 decimals). Absent while the task is still processing.

trace_id.description: 本次请求的追踪 ID，排查问题时提供给技术支持。

user_id.description: 发起该任务的账号 ID。

actor_user_id.description: 实际执行者的账号 ID。通过授权代发时与 `user_id` 不同。

api_id.description: 该任务所属接口的 ID。

application_id.description: 该任务计费所用应用的 ID。

credential_id.description: 发起该任务所用凭证的 ID。

authorization_id.description: 该任务使用的授权 ID。未通过授权发起时为 null。

status.description: Task state. 'processing' means keep polling; 'ready' means the token field is populated.

token.description: The solved verification token (token APIs). Present only when status is 'ready'.

solution.description: The recognition result for recognition/recaptcha2 and recognition/hcaptcha. Present only when status is 'ready'.

text.description: The recognized text for recognition/image2text. Present only when status is 'ready'.

error.message: no task_id specified

400.description: Bad request, possibly due to a missing task_id.

error.message: The specified token is invalid or wrong.

401.description: Unauthorized, invalid or missing authorization token.

error.message: task not found

404.description: The specified task_id does not exist.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specifies the format of the response from the server.

task_id.description: The task id returned when a token API was called with async=true.

post.description: Poll the result of an asynchronous captcha task. Submit the task_id returned by any captcha API (token or recognition) called with async=true; the response reports status 'processing' until solved, then returns the result — token for token APIs, solution for recognition classification, or text for image2text. Billing happens once, only when the task is successfully solved.
